CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_State_CRM
AS
BEGIN
--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_State
AS(
    SELECT
     BCC.[VALUE] AS StateId
    ,BCC.DESCRIPTION  AS StateName
    ,BCC.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BCC.CATEGORYID AS CategoryId
    ,'CRM' AS SourceSystemCode
    ,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
    ,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
FROM BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES_DELTA BCCD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.CRM_CATEGORIES BCC ON BCCD.CATEGORYID = BCC.CATEGORYID AND BCCD.BANK_ID = BCC.BANK_ID AND BCC.ISLATEST = 1 AND CATEGORYTYPE = 'STATE'
WHERE BCC.CATEGORYID IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_State FROM TEMP_BNKM_State;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_State_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
StateId
,StateName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, StateId,FinancialInstitutionId, RECORD_STATUS ,CATEGORYID
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_State WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_State_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
StateId
,StateName
,FinancialInstitutionId 
,CategoryId 
)) HASHROW, StateId, FinancialInstitutionId ,CATEGORYID
FROM BNKM.State --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'CRM'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_State_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.StateId,TGT.StateId) AS StateId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CATEGORYID,TGT.CATEGORYID) AS CATEGORYID
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_State_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_State_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.StateId = TGT.StateId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_State_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_State_DELTA;

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 StateId  = SRC.StateId 
,StateName  = SRC.StateName 
,CategoryId  = SRC.CategoryId 
FROM BNKM.[State] TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_State_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.StateId = TGT.StateId AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND DELTA.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_State SRC ON SRC.StateId = TGT.StateId AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId AND SRC.CATEGORYID = TGT.CATEGORYID ;
 

----INSERT TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.[State]
([StateId]
,[StateName]
,[CensusDivisionId]
,[FipsCode]
,[StateUspsCode]
,[FinancialInstitutionId]
,[CategoryId]
,[SourceSystemCode]
,[WorkFlowId]
,[TaskRunId]
,[InsertDttm] )

SELECT
     StateId AS StateId
    ,StateName AS StateName
    ,NULL AS CensusDivisionId
    ,NULL AS FipsCode
    ,NULL AS StateUspsCode
    ,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CategoryId AS CategoryId
    ,SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
    ,0 AS WorkFlowId
    ,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_State
WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'INSERT'

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_State;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_State_DELTA;

END
